about: Where the registries deviate from what dev/rosters/validate.py expects, id by id, with the reason. Every line is a place where the scripts disagreed before the registries existed (2026-10-13): the registry reproduces it exactly and nobody has ruled on it, unless the reason says it is deliberate. validate.py fails on a deviation that is not listed here, and on a line here that no longer deviates. To accept a new one: add `id: reason` under its rule.

hp-not-x3.mutantmonsters:mutant_zombie: miniboss: the x3 is for trophy bosses (the boundary written in scaling/zz_boss_global_3x.js); open: add some minibosses to the x3
hp-not-x3.deeperdarker:sculk_centipede: on no kill roster, designed health 650, no x3: see mutant_zombie; open: should it pay miniboss tokens
